headline: Google reports an early VLA robotics proof of concept for astronaut logistics
summary: Google Cloud's Oct 27 account describes a physical robotic proof of concept developed with NASA Johnson Space Center and JPL for possible deep-space logistics and medical-equipment support. Google reports an initial 85% pick-and-place success baseline in early lab environments and says the fine-tuned model can run locally on compact edge devices. The article mentions MuJoCo simulation before real hardware but does not say whether the 85% trials were simulated or hardware-run, or give a denominator and success criteria. These are first-party reports, not independent measurements, and do not establish flight readiness or quantified edge efficiency.
